dialogues.speaker: Yukio
dialogues.text: Poultry skewer with BBQ sauce, salty grilled fish, kitsune ramen... Dear customer, how would you like to try some native Inazuma snacks?

dialogues.speaker: Yukio
dialogues.text: We also serve tea. We have genmaicha, barley, and oolong. Which one would you like? We do not serve alcohol, though.
